podcasts.name: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs

podcast.title: Continued Performance
podcast.body: Herman Santiago continues to perform with a version of The Teenagers to this day, making him one of the longest-standing members. "A version of the band continues to this day, still featuring Herman Santiago."

podcast.title: Legal Battle for Song Credit
podcast.body: In 1992, Santiago and Jimmy Merchant finally won legal credit for having written "Why Do Fools Fall in Love." However, this victory was overturned in 1996 due to the lapse of time in taking legal action, causing the song rights to revert to Frankie Lymon's estate and Morris Levy. "In 1992, Santiago and Merchant finally won the credit for having written Why the Fools Fall in Love, but in 1996 the ruling was overturned."

podcast.title: Primary Writer of "Why Do Fools Fall in Love"
podcast.body: Herman Santiago wrote "Why Do Fools Fall in Love" with assistance from Jimmy Merchant, though he was not credited for his contribution when the song was initially released. "Why the fools fall in love, was written by Herman Santiago, with the help of Jimmy Merchant."
